decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the firm's established market-data offer, is still presented on its own page, and fits the announced platform direction, so the firm's investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.

Although the calculator moved from its own page to a mere mention, it sits close to the core tariff-data business and costs little to maintain, so management will likely justify keeping it as part of the platform despite weaker visibility.

The area definition tool is an enabling component of the firm's location-based offers, and its reduced visibility can be read as integration into the central platform rather than failure, so sunk development effort argues for retaining it.
